## About
Bernie's Tire Service is family owned and operated. Our founder, Bernie F. Beri Sr., started out with one simple idea: a tire company that would show up when customers needed help. Bernie Jr. picked up where his father left off, and as he puts it, "There's rubber running through the veins of the Beri family."
We sell new and used tires, and the price you see on a new tire covers what it takes to get it on your car. No appointment needed. Just stop by the shop on Torresdale Avenue.
Folks come back to us, and we get to know them and their kids. That's why we're rated 4.4 from 318 Google reviews.

## Services
- Car Tire Sales: New tires for your car, with mounting, balancing, valve stems and old tire disposal included in the price.
- New and used tires: Need a budget option? We sell used tires as well as new.
- Truck Tire Division: The business started as a truck tire company, and we still have a truck tire division.
- Tires fixed and replaced: One customer stopped in to get tires fixed and replaced and called it great service all around.

## FAQ
Q: Is an appointment needed?
A: No appointment needed. Just come by during business hours.

Q: What's included in the price of a new tire?
A: Mounting, balancing, valve stems and old tire disposal are all part of the price.

Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: Yes. We sell both new and used tires.

Q: How close are you to the Tacony Bridge?
A: We're only 5 minutes from the Tacony Bridge, on Torresdale Avenue in Philadelphia.
